text: When resharding finishes for a collection archived by Atlas Online Archive, its online archive files are marked Orphaned. Orphaning therefore does not require a missing cluster: collection deletion or resharding can orphan an archive associated with an active or paused archive configuration. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Those sources support the identity risk, not Atlas archive-state behavior. (high confidence)
